name: Santa's Countdown
author: BigC07
description: An animated countdown to Christmas for kids: Santa's sleigh and reindeer, waving snowmen, bouncing presents, dancing gingerbread men, flashing lights, Santa stuck in a chimney, elves throwing presents and elves building one in their workshop -- a different scene each time it comes round. All art drawn in code; no network.

versions.notes: Taller panels: the rows above and below the card get the scene's sky -- falling snow or twinkling stars, in dots the size of the card's -- instead of plain black, and the snowman's ground runs to the bottom of the panel. A doubled card always keeps at least 64 columns, so a 64x64 panel shows the 64-wide card rather than a cramped 32-wide one. The workshop gets a narrow layout: below 96 columns one elf hammers at a short bench, from 96 both elves work.

First release. Eight animated scenes drawn in code -- sleigh, snowman, presents, gingerbread, lights, chimney, elves, workshop -- shown in turn (or at random), with the days left until Christmas, and MERRY CHRISTMAS! on the day. Shows from season_start (1 November by default) through Christmas Day and stays off the rest of the year. In Vegas it is one live element the ticker redraws in place, so the card animates while it scrolls (core 3.8.0+; older cores get a still frame), and it moves to the next scene every lap, even with nothing else in the rotation.
